scope: Independent code and physics-invariant verification of the retained bank demolition candidate. Native player capture and human visual acceptance remain separate.

independent_context.inputs: actual implementation diffs, source, unchanged suite, supplied criteria and standing invariants; no builder reasoning or narrative evidence used

standing_invariants: material retention and unique settlement scoring
finite bounded state and section allocation
current geometry controls physical contact and damage
complete immutable snapshots and deterministic continued physics
recorded timeline preserves history, exact past restore, alternate futures and pristine rebuild
existing controls, district and ball behavior remain valid

checks.name: preserved initial collision repros
details: Loose architecture lands on moving connected slab with momentum transfer and breakup.
Wide section edge detects a stationary solid across a grid boundary and does not pass entirely through it.

checks.name: preserved reverse collision repro
checks.details: A connected slab falling onto loose airborne rubble exchanges momentum and breaks instead of passing through.

checks.name: fresh-instance restored continuation and alternate futures
existing locality, substantial native-strength charge collapse, connected motion, final settlement, retention, scoring, one-minute history and pristine rebuild
existing furnishing, ball-contact, district, water-tower and ordinary rubble behavior
membership, integration order, contact lookup and captured hidden solver state code review
checks.details: Reviewed current section ownership, moved-body handoff, transient derived contact data, fixed-size retained bodies, reusable section allocation and serialized member/node/section state; no remaining proven blocker in the bounded review.

checks.name: existing gates preserved
checks.details: No pre-existing test assertions were removed or relaxed. The preserved independent contact repros were not changed.

checks.name: diff whitespace and clean candidate checkout

resolved_failures.issue: Moving loose pieces crossed a connected slab; wide section edges missed adjacent spatial cells.
Connected slab crossed lower loose rubble.
Two collapse scenarios retained 163 and 130 loose pieces; falling stone failed to move the writing table.

limitations: This is a bounded independent technical audit, not exhaustive contact-space certification.
Native browser controls, actual playback appearance and human visual/taste acceptance were not claimed by these diagnostic fixtures.
Test durations are test-run wall time, not native browser performance measurements.

reproduction.instruction: Pass the candidate build directory explicitly to each independent script; preserved defaults point to the original inspection worktree.
